integrity: Structural proof and independently enumerated small-field graph; no claim of independent external review.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the five-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra. Verification exhausts only the prime fields of orders two and three; proof is for all prime powers. Unindexed equivalent symplectic graph enumerations remain possible.
title: Full valency spectrum of the five-dimensional Heisenberg comaximal graph
